ops.text: Visibility into cross-team handoffs without parallel spreadsheets
ops.rationale: Teams keep a shadow Google Sheet because Flowstack doesn't show handoffs clearly.

ops.text: Faster onboarding so new PMs trust the product without veteran workarounds
ops.rationale: New hires take 3–4 weeks before they trust Flowstack; veterans rely on untaught workarounds.

ops.text: Ask how often they reconcile the shadow spreadsheet and who owns it
ops.rationale: Manual Friday reconciliation suggests a recurring workaround worth quantifying.

ops.text: Onboarding cliff and undocumented veteran workarounds
ops.rationale: Trust gap for new PMs vs mental models veterans built outside the UI.

ops.text: Ask what workaround they mentioned and why they didn't return to it live
ops.rationale: They lost the follow-up thread during the call and only recovered it from Otter afterward.

ops.text: In-the-moment follow-up support during live interviews
ops.rationale: Pain is specific to losing threads while the conversation is still happening.

ops.text: Approvals surfaced in-product instead of stranded in email
ops.rationale: Simple requests sit pending for days because approvers live in email, not Flowstack.

ops.text: Return to the approval bottleneck — who are the approvers and where do they work?
ops.rationale: They noted this thread on Tuesday but never followed up while still on the call.

ops.text: Ask what the Friday spreadsheet reconciliation actually fixes
ops.rationale: Same missed call also surfaced the shadow spreadsheet workaround again.

ops.text: Less reactive post-call reconstruction work
ops.rationale: Post-call synthesis takes 45–60 minutes and rebuilds what was missed live.

ops.text: Signal over noise in alerts so blockers aren't buried
ops.rationale: Ops leads mute Flowstack alerts and miss real blockers in routine updates.

ops.text: Richer deep links between Slack/Jira and in-product context
ops.rationale: People paste screenshots because links don't carry enough state across tools.

ops.text: Leadership rollup view of where work is stuck
ops.rationale: Directors ping three people because there's no trusted rollup view.

ops.text: Workflow changes may spike support load without in-product guidance
ops.rationale: Support tickets spike for two weeks after workflow updates ship.

ops.text: Integration friction between Slack threads and Flowstack
ops.rationale: Context jumps between tools; screenshots substitute for portable state.

ops.text: Chat-style AI output may feel like distraction during camera-on calls
ops.rationale: Granola felt like another chat window dumping text while trying to stay present.

ops.text: How this differs from summary-after tools like Teams Copilot
ops.rationale: They contrasted in-the-moment help with post-call summaries.

ops.text: Stable spatial layout as a habit-forming affordance
ops.rationale: They valued knowing where to look instead of hunting for the latest AI paragraph.

ops.text: Suggestion churn and scroll-jank could cause them to ignore the product
ops.rationale: Repeated bullets and wrong-time scrolling were explicit turn-off triggers.

ops.text: Confirm dedupe expectations: discarded items stay gone unless new evidence appears
ops.rationale: They expect discard to be conversation-scoped, not cosmetic.

ops.text: Repeated near-duplicate suggestions are worse than silence
ops.rationale: Four pricing prompts from one mention of budget would kill trust.

ops.text: Custom modes and card templates per research study
ops.rationale: They want jobs-to-be-done and unmet needs without rebuilding the whole UI.

ops.text: Ask which card types are non-negotiable vs nice-to-have per call type
ops.rationale: Follow-up questions and customer needs were called non-negotiable.

ops.text: Align PM speed, ops audit trail, and IT security requirements in one account
ops.rationale: Same customer voices conflicting jobs-to-be-done across stakeholders.

ops.text: Enterprise security reviews can block feature adoption after purchase
ops.rationale: Security reviews stall external sharing; customers want the product but can't enable features.

ops.text: Multi-stakeholder misalignment inside a single customer account
ops.rationale: PM, ops, and IT want different outcomes from the same deployment.

ops.text: Rationale text and keyboard shortcuts for pin/discard during live calls
ops.rationale: Rationale builds trust; they cannot mouse around during interviews.

ops.text: Privacy and cloud-processing clarity is deal-breaker territory
ops.rationale: Enterprise participants ask where audio goes; real-time AI implies cloud processing.

ops.text: Seat economics and budget pushback may block expansion
ops.rationale: Small teams want fewer paid seats with broader read access; budget holders resist another tool.

ops.text: Ask what proof of value leadership needs before renewing seats
ops.rationale: Reporting gap hurts procurement when they can't prove value without manual exports.

ops.text: Pricing, seat model, and proving ROI to budget holders
ops.rationale: Pricing and seat economics come up every quarter alongside stack consolidation pressure.

ops.text: Validate priority: low-noise follow-up cards over novel features
ops.rationale: They want fewer missed threads in the 45 minutes that matter.

ops.text: Session export that respects pins versus discards
ops.rationale: Second priority after reliable follow-up question cards.
